Dos Quebradas area, to the northwest of the QB deposit, was subject to an IP/resistivity survey, which indicated zones of high chargeability and high electrical conductivity anomalies in the subsurface.
A ZTEM survey was completed in 2023. Geophysical anomalies were drill tested, and indicated elevated sulphide and copper values.
